description:
User, 2026-11-18, verbatim via Optimize: "note the discrepancy as a ticket at the end of the epic." Optimize's reading (not confirmed by the user): the discrepancy is this map-order difference. If the user meant the case_a_40 guard miss, fz-sc8.192.15 covers it and this ticket is closed.

fz lists a small atom-keyed map's keys by name. Elixir 1.19.4 / OTP 28 lists them by atom-table index, so an atom the VM interned early sorts ahead of later ones:
  IO.inspect(Map.put(%{a: 1, b: nil}, :c, 0))   Elixir %{c: 0, a: 1, b: nil}   fz %{a: 1, b: nil, c: 0}
  IO.inspect(%{a: 1, b: nil, c: 0})             the same difference
  Map.to_list of it                              Elixir [c: 0, a: 1, b: nil]     fz [a: 1, b: nil, c: 0]
  with :zebra_fresh_atom in place of :c          both agree
It predates this epic: develop prints the same. Repro: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-map-traces/ord.fz.

Context: fz-sc8.192.6's approved page v2 withdrew the v1 decisions on atom order, because atom ids are not stable. fz-sc8.219 records the oracle side of the same thing: Elixir's order for an atom-keyed map is not defined across runs and versions (01174). So "match Elixir" may not be a reachable target; the decision this ticket asks for is which order fz promises, and where that is written down (guides, and the oracle rule for fixtures).

Placed at the end of fz-sc8.192; it blocks nothing.

comments.text: Concordant evidence (Bugs and Cleanup, 2026-11-19): ORACLE=regen locally with Elixir 1.19.4 / OTP 28 rewrites fixtures 01174 and 01760 — small atom-key maps print in a different order (%{b: 3, a: 1} vs %{a: 1, b: 3}). CI pins OTP 28.5.0.1 / Elixir 1.19.5 (.github/workflows/ci.yml:37-38). OTP orders a small map's atom keys by atom-table index, so the golden depends on which atoms the Elixir build created first: oracle goldens with small atom-key maps are only reproducible on CI's exact versions.
Second report (Optimize, 2026-11-19): ORACLE=regen on 1.19.4/OTP 28 rewrites 01760's atom-key maps again. CI's 1.19.5 golden stands.

title: A map's atom keys are listed in the order Elixir lists them, or the difference is a documented one
